Light of the Jedi'' |author=[[Charles Soule]] |cover artist=[[Joseph Meehan]]{{ArtStation|username=meehanjo|name=Joseph Meehan}} |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=[[January 5]], [[2021]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/622991/star-wars-light-of-the-jedi-the-high-republic-by-charles-soule|text=Star Wars: Light of the Jedi (The High Republic)}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=*Hardcover *Paperback *eBook |pages=380 |isbn=9780593157718 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi (audiobook)|Audiobook]] |timeline=[[232 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' to [[232 BBY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' {{C|[[Phase I: Light of the Jedi|Phase I]]}} |preceded by= |followed by=[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm|''The Rising Storm'']] }} {{Quote|I'm hopeful that when people read Light of the Jedi on January 5 that they will find themes that will be resonant because of the time in which it's coming out and because of the time in which it was written.|Charles Soule|{{SW|url=news/the-makers-of-star-wars-the-high-republic-charles-soule|text=The Makers of ''Star Wars: The High Republic'': Charles Soule on ''Light of the Jedi''}}}} '''''The High Republic: Light of the Jedi''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Charles Soule]]. It is the first release in the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' publishing campaign, and was published on [[January 5]], [[2021]] by [[Del Rey]]. An [[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi (audiobook)|audiobook adaptation]] narrated by [[Marc Thompson]] was released the same day. The events of the novel are set two [[Standard century|centuries]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and the story follows [[Jedi Master]] [[Avar Kriss]] and other [[Jedi]] as the [[Jedi Order]] faces a new threat, the [[Nihil]].
